inputSpec.scalarDistribution: uniform 1 <= k < secp256k1 order; reject out-of-range candidates
inputSpec.pointDomain: two non-infinity points with different x coordinates
inputSpec.inputDigest: sha3-256 of sequential tx,ty,ox,oy as 32-byte little-endian coordinates
inputSpec.errorRule: union of classical, phase and workspace failures by input; at most 1
